description: Return the per-principle mapping back to specific Magnifica Humanitas paragraphs, with convergence scores from 4 independent extraction methods. All 13 principles converge at 4/4 (strong consensus across distillation methods). Call this when the user asks 'where does this come from in the encyclical', 'cite the source', 'show me the paragraph numbers', OR when an agent needs to build a citation footnote for academic or pastoral use. Use `format=summary` for compact citation lookup (principle key → MH paragraph range). Use `format=full` (default) for trust/integrity evaluation with per-method convergence detail. The response's `_validation.allConvergence` should be "4/4" — anything lower is a flag for follow-up review.

format.description: 'full' (default) returns per-method convergence detail. 'summary' returns just the principle-key → MH-paragraph mapping (smaller, faster, fine for citation lookup).

name: get_traceability
